shelf_entry.definition: A flat horizontal board or surface fixed above the floor or within a frame to hold objects.
shelf_entry.example: The top shelf holds the larger boxes.

image.brief: Show one clearly emphasized horizontal shelf within a simple shelving frame, carrying a few boxes with space above and below it. Use lighting and a close crop to identify that single support surface without a printed word or colored label. Reject an entire aisle, a freestanding table, or a wall cabinet. Inspect the Mini Market shelf lead and avoid overfilling it.
